description.zh: 组织ID列表，列表元素数量最多不超过100。
description.en: The list of organizational unit IDs. The number of IDs in the list cannot exceed 100.

description.zh: 组织名称，查询为精确匹配查询。
description.en: The name of the organizational unit. An exact match is used for the query.

description.zh: 组织名称前缀，查询为左匹配查询。
description.en: The prefix of the name of the organizational unit. A left-side match is used for the query.
The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 列表大小，默认20，最大不超过100。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100.
The ID of the parent organizational unit.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam list-organizational-units --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --organizational-unit-ids ou_wovwffm62xifdziem7an7xxxxx --organizational-unit-name name_001 --organizational-unit-name-starts-with name --parent-id ou_wovwffm62xifdziem7an7xxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam ListOrganizationalUnits --region cn-hangzhou --ParentId ou_wovwffm62xifdziem7an7xxxxx --PageSize 20 --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --PageNumber 1 --OrganizationalUnitNameStartsWith name --OrganizationalUnitName name_001 --OrganizationalUnitIds.1 ou_wovwffm62xifdziem7an7xxxxx --method POST --force
